```{r PART 0: Data Preparation}

inhibition_df <- read.xlsx(file.path(input_dir, "Inhibition.xlsx"), na.strings = c("NA", "not available"))

compound_metrics <- data.frame(
  Compound       = colnames(l2fc_matrix),
  N_Regulated    = colSums(regulation_matrix_combined, na.rm = TRUE),
  Mean_AbsL2FC   = colMeans(abs(l2fc_matrix), na.rm = TRUE),
  Euclidean_Dist = sqrt(colSums(l2fc_matrix^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
  N_Up           = colSums(l2fc_matrix > FC_THRESHOLD, na.rm = TRUE),
  N_Down         = colSums(l2fc_matrix < -FC_THRESHOLD, na.rm = TRUE),
  N_Extreme      = colSums(abs(l2fc_matrix) > 1.5, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Up_Down_Ratio = log2((N_Up + 1) / (N_Down + 1)),
    Pct_Regulated = N_Regulated / nrow(l2fc_matrix) * 100
  )

compound_metrics <- left_join(compound_metrics, inhibition_df, by = "Compound")


conc_colname <- grep(
  "Concentration|conc",
  colnames(compound_metrics),
  value = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)[1]

cat(sprintf("Detected concentration column name: %s\n", conc_colname))

if (!is.null(conc_colname) && conc_colname != "Concentration") {
  compound_metrics <- compound_metrics %>%
    rename(Concentration = !!sym(conc_colname))
}

compound_metrics <- compound_metrics %>%
  mutate(Log10_Conc = log10(Concentration))

cat(sprintf("Total compounds: %d\n", nrow(compound_metrics)))
cat(sprintf("With inhibition rate: %d\n", sum(!is.na(compound_metrics$Inhibition_Rate))))
cat(sprintf(
  "NA inhibition rate: %d (not measured / CCK-8 interference by color)\n",
  sum(is.na(compound_metrics$Inhibition_Rate))
))
cat("\nConcentration distribution:\n")
print(table(compound_metrics$Concentration))
```

```{r PART 1: Diagnostic for Concentration Confounding Effects}

  if (nrow(sub) >= 10) {

      sub$Euclidean_Dist,
      sub$Inhibition_Rate,

      conc, ct$estimate, ct$p.value, nrow(sub)
    ))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  %5g μM: n = %d (too few samples; skipped)\n", conc, nrow(sub)))
  }
}

ct_raw <- cor.test(
  compound_metrics$Euclidean_Dist,
  compound_metrics$Inhibition_Rate,
  method = "spearman",
  exact = FALSE
)

cat(sprintf(
  "\nOverall Spearman (not controlling for concentration): rho = %.3f, p = %.2e\n",

))
```

```{r PART 2: Protein–Toxicity Partial Correlation (Controlled for Concentration}

inhibition_vec <- compound_metrics$Inhibition_Rate
conc_vec       <- compound_metrics$Log10_Conc

partial_spearman <- function(x, y, z) {
  valid <- complete.cases(x, y, z)
  if (sum(valid) < 15) return(list(rho = NA, p = NA))
  x <- x[valid]; y <- y[valid]; z <- z[valid]
  rx <- rank(x); ry <- rank(y); rz <- rank(z)
  res_x <- residuals(lm(rx ~ rz))
  res_y <- residuals(lm(ry ~ rz))
  ct <- cor.test(res_x, res_y, method = "pearson")  
  return(list(rho = ct$estimate, p = ct$p.value))
}

protein_names <- rownames(l2fc_matrix)
n_proteins <- length(protein_names)

partial_results <- data.frame(
  Protein     = protein_names,
  Partial_rho = rep(NA_real_, n_proteins),
  Partial_p   = rep(NA_real_, n_proteins),
  Raw_rho     = rep(NA_real_, n_proteins),
  Raw_p       = rep(NA_real_, n_proteins),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Computing partial correlations...\n")
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_proteins, style = 3)

for (i in seq_len(n_proteins)) {
  prot_vals <- l2fc_matrix[i, ]
  valid_raw <- !is.na(prot_vals) & !is.na(inhibition_vec)

  if (sum(valid_raw) >= 15) {
    ct_raw <- cor.test(
      prot_vals[valid_raw],
      inhibition_vec[valid_raw],
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
    partial_results$Raw_rho[i] <- ct_raw$estimate
    partial_results$Raw_p[i]   <- ct_raw$p.value
  }

  pc <- partial_spearman(prot_vals, inhibition_vec, conc_vec)
  partial_results$Partial_rho[i] <- pc$rho
  partial_results$Partial_p[i]   <- pc$p

  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
}
close(pb)

partial_results <- partial_results %>%
  mutate(
    Raw_FDR     = p.adjust(Raw_p, method = "BH"),
    Partial_FDR = p.adjust(Partial_p, method = "BH"),
    Raw_Sig     = Raw_FDR < 0.05,
    Partial_Sig = Partial_FDR < 0.05,
    Direction_Partial = case_when(
      Partial_Sig & Partial_rho > 0 ~ "Up → Kill (controlled)",
      Partial_Sig & Partial_rho < 0 ~ "Down → Kill (controlled)",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Partial_p)

cat(sprintf(
  "\nSignificant proteins (raw; not controlling concentration): %d\n",
  sum(partial_results$Raw_Sig, na.rm = TRUE)
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Significant proteins (partial; concentration-controlled):  %d\n",
  sum(partial_results$Partial_Sig, na.rm = TRUE)
))

both_sig     <- sum(partial_results$Raw_Sig & partial_results$Partial_Sig, na.rm = TRUE)
only_raw     <- sum(partial_results$Raw_Sig & !partial_results$Partial_Sig, na.rm = TRUE)
only_partial <- sum(!partial_results$Raw_Sig & partial_results$Partial_Sig, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf(
  "Both significant: %d | Only raw significant: %d | Only partial significant: %d\n",
  both_sig, only_raw, only_partial
))

p_compare <- ggplot(
  partial_results %>% filter(!is.na(Raw_rho), !is.na(Partial_rho)),
  aes(x = Raw_rho, y = Partial_rho)
) +
  geom_point(aes(color = case_when(
    Raw_Sig & Partial_Sig ~ "Both significant",
    Raw_Sig & !Partial_Sig ~ "Lost after controlling conc",
    !Raw_Sig & Partial_Sig ~ "Gained after controlling conc",
    TRUE ~ "Neither"
  )), alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Both significant" = "#e41a1c",
    "Lost after controlling conc" = "#ff7f00",
    "Gained after controlling conc" = "#377eb8",
    "Neither" = "gray80"
  ), name = "") +
  labs(
    title = "Impact of Controlling for Concentration",
    x = "Raw Spearman ρ",
    y = "Partial Spearman ρ (conc-controlled)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1, legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_compare)

p_volcano_partial <- ggplot(
  partial_results,
  aes(x = Partial_rho, y = -log10(Partial_FDR))
) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Direction_Partial), alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = . %>% filter(Partial_Sig) %>% slice_min(Partial_FDR, n = 30),
    aes(label = Protein),
    size = 2.3,
    max.overlaps = 30
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Up → Kill (controlled)"   = "#D13A7A",
    "Down → Kill (controlled)" = "#047499",
    "Not significant"          = "gray80"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Protein–Toxicity Association (Concentration-Controlled)",
    subtitle = "Partial Spearman correlation controlling for log10(concentration)",
    x = "Partial Spearman ρ",
    y = expression(-log[10] * "(FDR)")
  ) +
  theme_bw() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

print(p_volcano_partial)

tox_up_proteins   <- partial_results %>% filter(Partial_Sig, Partial_rho >  0.3) %>% pull(Protein)
tox_down_proteins <- partial_results %>% filter(Partial_Sig, Partial_rho < -0.3) %>% pull(Protein)

cat(sprintf(
  "\nProteins positively associated with toxicity (|ρ|>0.3): %d\n",
  length(tox_up_proteins)
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Proteins negatively associated with toxicity (|ρ|>0.3): %d\n",
  length(tox_down_proteins)
))

write.xlsx(partial_results, file.path(data_dir, "Plot01_partial_results.xlsx"))
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Plot01_partial_results.pdf"), p_volcano_partial, width = 7, height = 7)
```

```{r PART 4: Elastic Net + Feature-Number Sensitivity Analysis}

# 4.1 Base elastic net modeling 
X_prot <- t(l2fc_matrix)
X_conc <- compound_metrics$Log10_Conc
X_full <- cbind(X_prot, Log10_Conc = X_conc)
y <- compound_metrics$Inhibition_Rate

valid_idx <- complete.cases(X_full) & !is.na(y)
X_clean <- X_full[valid_idx, ]
y_clean <- y[valid_idx]

cat(sprintf("Modeling sample size: %d (excluding %d missing values)\n", sum(valid_idx), sum(!valid_idx)))

n_features <- ncol(X_clean)
penalty_vec <- rep(1, n_features)
penalty_vec[n_features] <- 0 

set.seed(42)
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
  X_clean, y_clean,
  alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 10,
  penalty.factor = penalty_vec
)

best_coef <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")

protein_coefs <- data.frame(
  Protein = rownames(best_coef)[-1][best_coef[-1, 1] != 0 & rownames(best_coef)[-1] != "Log10_Conc"],
  Coefficient = best_coef[-1, 1][best_coef[-1, 1] != 0 & rownames(best_coef)[-1] != "Log10_Conc"],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(Abs_Coef = abs(Coefficient)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Abs_Coef))

intercept_value <- best_coef["(Intercept)", 1]
conc_coef <- best_coef["Log10_Conc", 1]

cat(sprintf("\nElastic net selected total proteins: %d\n", nrow(protein_coefs)))
cat(sprintf("Intercept: %.4f, Log10_Conc coefficient: %.4f\n", intercept_value, conc_coef))


# 4.2 Stability selection (consistent with original logic; loosen threshold to 0.5 to avoid too-small candidate pools)
set.seed(123)
n_boot <- 100

prot_only_names <- colnames(X_clean)[colnames(X_clean) != "Log10_Conc"]

selection_matrix <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(prot_only_names),
  ncol = n_boot,
  dimnames = list(prot_only_names, NULL)
)

for (i in 1:n_boot) {
  idx <- sample(
    1:nrow(X_clean),
    size = floor(0.8 * nrow(X_clean)),
    replace = FALSE
  )

  cv_fit_b <- cv.glmnet(
    X_clean[idx, ], y_clean[idx],
    alpha = 0.5,
    penalty.factor = penalty_vec,
    nfolds = 5
  )

  coef_i <- coef(cv_fit_b, s = "lambda.min")
  selected <- setdiff(
    rownames(coef_i)[coef_i[, 1] != 0],
    c("(Intercept)", "Log10_Conc")
  )
  selection_matrix[selected, i] <- 1
}

stability_df <- data.frame(
  Protein = rownames(selection_matrix),
  Selection_Frequency = rowMeans(selection_matrix)
) %>% arrange(desc(Selection_Frequency))


stable_proteins <- stability_df %>%
  filter(Selection_Frequency >= 0.6) %>%
  pull(Protein)

cat(sprintf("Number of stability-selected proteins (≥0.5): %d\n", length(stable_proteins)))


# 4.3 Random forest importance (consistent with original logic)
rf_proteins <- partial_results %>% filter(Partial_Sig) %>% pull(Protein)
rf_cols <- c(intersect(rf_proteins, colnames(X_clean)), "Log10_Conc")
X_rf <- X_clean[, rf_cols]

set.seed(42)
rf_fit <- randomForest(
  x = X_rf,
  y = y_clean,
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = max(floor(ncol(X_rf) / 3), 2),
  importance = TRUE
)

importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(rf_fit$importance),
  IncMSE = rf_fit$importance[, "%IncMSE"]
) %>% arrange(desc(IncMSE))


rf_high <- importance_df %>%
  filter(Feature != "Log10_Conc") %>%
  slice_max(IncMSE, prop = 0.8) %>%
  pull(Feature)

cat(sprintf("Number of high-importance proteins from random forest: %d\n", length(rf_high)))


# 4.4 Build candidate core protein pool (auto-adapt to avoid too-small pools)
core_intersect <- Reduce(intersect, list(protein_coefs$Protein, stable_proteins, rf_high))
cat(sprintf("Triple-intersection proteins count: %d\n", length(core_intersect)))

if (length(core_intersect) < 5) {
  cat("⚠️ Triple intersection < 5; relaxing candidate selection: at least 2 screening conditions\n")
  protein_condition <- data.frame(
    Protein = prot_only_names,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      In_Elastic = Protein %in% protein_coefs$Protein,
      In_Stable  = Protein %in% stable_proteins,
      In_RF       = Protein %in% rf_high,
      Condition_Count = In_Elastic + In_Stable + In_RF
    )

  candidate_pool <- protein_condition %>%
    filter(Condition_Count >= 2) %>%
    pull(Protein)
} else {
  candidate_pool <- core_intersect
}

candidate_pool <- protein_coefs %>%
  filter(Protein %in% candidate_pool) %>%
  pull(Protein)

cat(sprintf("Final candidate core protein pool size: %d\n", length(candidate_pool)))

if (length(candidate_pool) < 3) stop("Candidate core protein pool < 3; cannot perform sensitivity analysis. Please check screening criteria")


# 4.5 Feature-number sensitivity analysis (nested CV evaluating different N)
set.seed(42)
N_OUTER <- 5  
N_INNER <- 5

N_max <- length(candidate_pool)  
N_min <- max(3, min(5, N_max))   
N_range <- N_min:N_max


nested_r2_by_N <- data.frame(
  N = N_range,
  Mean_R2 = NA_real_,
  SD_R2 = NA_real_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(N_range), style = 3)

for (n_idx in seq_along(N_range)) {
  N_curr <- N_range[n_idx]
  curr_proteins <- head(candidate_pool, N_curr)
  X_curr <- X_clean[, c(curr_proteins, "Log10_Conc")]
  penalty_curr <- c(rep(1, N_curr), 0)
  outer_folds <- sample(rep(1:N_OUTER, length.out = nrow(X_curr)))
  r2_list <- numeric(N_OUTER)

  for (k in 1:N_OUTER) {
    tr <- which(outer_folds != k)
    te <- which(outer_folds == k)
    cv_k <- cv.glmnet(
      X_curr[tr, ], y_clean[tr],
      alpha = 0.5, nfolds = N_INNER,
      penalty.factor = penalty_curr
    )

    pred_k <- predict(cv_k, X_curr[te, ], s = "lambda.min")[, 1]
    r2_list[k] <- 1 - sum((pred_k - y_clean[te])^2) /
      sum((y_clean[te] - mean(y_clean[tr]))^2)
  }

  nested_r2_by_N$Mean_R2[n_idx] <- mean(r2_list)
  nested_r2_by_N$SD_R2[n_idx] <- sd(r2_list)
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, n_idx)
}
close(pb)

print(nested_r2_by_N)


# 4.6 Elbow method to determine optimal core protein number
nested_r2_by_N$R2_diff <- c(NA, diff(nested_r2_by_N$Mean_R2))


elbow_idx <- which(nested_r2_by_N$R2_diff < 0.01 | nested_r2_by_N$R2_diff < -0.005)[1]
if (is.na(elbow_idx)) elbow_idx <- nrow(nested_r2_by_N) 
optimal_N <- nested_r2_by_N$N[elbow_idx]

cat(sprintf("\n★ Optimal core protein number (Elbow-selected): %d\n", optimal_N))
cat(sprintf(
  "  Corresponding nested CV R²: %.3f ± %.3f\n",
  nested_r2_by_N$Mean_R2[elbow_idx], nested_r2_by_N$SD_R2[elbow_idx]
))

p_elbow <- ggplot(nested_r2_by_N, aes(x = N, y = Mean_R2)) +
  geom_line(color = "#377eb8", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "#e41a1c", size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean_R2 - SD_R2, ymax = Mean_R2 + SD_R2),
    width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = optimal_N, linetype = "dashed", color = "#d73027", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = optimal_N + 0.2,
    y = min(nested_r2_by_N$Mean_R2),
    label = sprintf("Optimal N = %d", optimal_N),
    color = "#d73027",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Feature-Number Sensitivity Analysis",
    subtitle = "Nested CV R² vs number of core proteins (Elbow selects optimal N)",
    x = "Number of core proteins",
    y = "Nested CV R² (mean ± SD)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

print(p_elbow)


# 4.7 Determine final core proteins
core_proteins <- head(candidate_pool, optimal_N)
N_CORE_ACTUAL <- length(core_proteins)

cat(sprintf("\nFinal selected core protein count (CPS-%d): %d\n", N_CORE_ACTUAL, N_CORE_ACTUAL))
print(core_proteins)
```

```{r PART 5: Bootstrap Confidence Annotations}

set.seed(42)
outer_folds <- sample(rep(1:N_OUTER, length.out = nrow(X_clean)))

nested_results <- data.frame(Fold = 1:N_OUTER, R2 = NA_real_)

for (k in 1:N_OUTER) {
  tr <- which(outer_folds != k)
  te <- which(outer_folds == k)

  cv_k <- cv.glmnet(X_clean[tr, ], y_clean[tr], alpha = 0.5,
                    nfolds = N_INNER, penalty.factor = penalty_vec)

  pred_k <- predict(cv_k, X_clean[te, ], s = "lambda.min")[, 1]

  nested_results$R2[k] <- 1 - sum((pred_k - y_clean[te])^2) /
    sum((y_clean[te] - mean(y_clean[tr]))^2)
}

cat(sprintf(
  "Full-feature nested CV R²: %.3f ± %.3f\n",
  mean(nested_results$R2), sd(nested_results$R2)
))


set.seed(42)
n_boot <- 200

all_feature_names <- colnames(X_clean)
boot_freq <- setNames(rep(0, length(all_feature_names)), all_feature_names)

boot_coef_sign <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = n_boot,
  ncol = length(all_feature_names),
  dimnames = list(NULL, all_feature_names)
)

boot_oob_r2 <- numeric(n_boot)

cat("Running 200x Bootstrap elastic net...\n")
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_boot, style = 3)

for (b in 1:n_boot) {
  boot_idx <- sample(1:nrow(X_clean), replace = TRUE)
  oob_idx  <- setdiff(1:nrow(X_clean), unique(boot_idx))

  cv_b <- cv.glmnet(
    X_clean[boot_idx, ], y_clean[boot_idx],
    alpha = 0.5,
    nfolds = 5,
    penalty.factor = penalty_vec
  )

  coef_b <- coef(cv_b, s = "lambda.min")

  sel_b <- rownames(coef_b)[coef_b[, 1] != 0 & rownames(coef_b) != "(Intercept)"]

  boot_freq[sel_b] <- boot_freq[sel_b] + 1

  for (feat in sel_b) if (feat %in% all_feature_names) {
    boot_coef_sign[b, feat] <- sign(coef_b[feat, 1])
  }

  if (length(oob_idx) >= 10) {
    pred_oob <- predict(cv_b, X_clean[oob_idx, ], s = "lambda.min")[, 1]
    boot_oob_r2[b] <- 1 - sum((pred_oob - y_clean[oob_idx])^2) /
      sum((y_clean[oob_idx] - mean(y_clean[boot_idx]))^2)
  }

  setTxtProgressBar(pb, b)
}
close(pb)

boot_freq_pct <- boot_freq / n_boot * 100


core_annotated <- data.frame(Protein = core_proteins, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(protein_coefs, by = "Protein") %>%
  mutate(Boot_Select_Pct = boot_freq_pct[Protein])

core_annotated <- core_annotated %>%
  mutate(Boot_Sign_Consistency = sapply(seq_len(n()), function(i) {
    p <- Protein[i]
    signs <- boot_coef_sign[, p]
    signs <- signs[signs != 0]
    if (length(signs) == 0) return(NA)
    mean(signs == sign(Coefficient[i])) * 100
  }))

core_annotated <- core_annotated %>%
  mutate(Confidence = case_when(
    Boot_Select_Pct >= 70 & Boot_Sign_Consistency >= 80 ~ "High",
    Boot_Select_Pct >= 40 & Boot_Sign_Consistency >= 70 ~ "Moderate",
    Boot_Select_Pct >= 20                                ~ "Low (has alternatives)",
    TRUE                                                 ~ "Context-dependent"
  )) %>%
  left_join(partial_results %>% dplyr::select(Protein, Partial_rho, Partial_FDR), by = "Protein") %>%
  left_join(importance_df %>% dplyr::select(Feature, IncMSE), by = c("Protein" = "Feature")) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Coefficient)))

boot_oob_r2_valid <- boot_oob_r2[boot_oob_r2 != 0]

p_confidence <- ggplot(core_annotated, aes(x = reorder(Protein, abs(Coefficient)))) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Coefficient, fill = Confidence), alpha = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = Boot_Select_Pct / 100 * max(abs(Coefficient))),
    color = "black", size = 3
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "High" = "#d73027", "Moderate" = "#fc8d59",
    "Low (has alternatives)" = "#fee090", "Context-dependent" = "gray80"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Elastic Net Coefficient (bars)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ . / max(abs(core_annotated$Coefficient)) * 100,
      name = "Bootstrap Selection % (dots)"
    )
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Core Signature: %d Proteins with Bootstrap Confidence", N_CORE_ACTUAL),
    subtitle = "All retained; bootstrap annotates stability, not filters",
    x = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_confidence)

p_collective <- ggplot(data.frame(R2 = boot_oob_r2_valid), aes(x = R2)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4575b4", alpha = 0.7, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(boot_oob_r2_valid), color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(nested_results$R2), color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Collective Prediction is Stable Despite Feature Variation",
    x = "Out-of-Bag R²",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

print(p_collective)
```


```{r PART 6: Final Model}

final_core <- core_proteins
X_final <- X_clean[, c(final_core, "Log10_Conc")]
penalty_final <- c(rep(1, length(final_core)), 0)

set.seed(42)
cv_final <- cv.glmnet(X_final, y_clean, alpha = 0.5, nfolds = 10, penalty.factor = penalty_final)
pred_final <- predict(cv_final, X_final, s = "lambda.min")[, 1]
r2_final <- cor(pred_final, y_clean)^2

final_nested_r2 <- numeric(N_OUTER)

for (k in 1:N_OUTER) {
  te <- which(outer_folds == k)
  tr <- which(outer_folds != k)

  cv_k <- cv.glmnet(
    X_final[tr, ], y_clean[tr],
    alpha = 0.5,
    nfolds = N_INNER,
    penalty.factor = penalty_final
  )

  pred_k <- predict(cv_k, X_final[te, ], s = "lambda.min")[, 1]

  final_nested_r2[k] <- 1 - sum((pred_k - y_clean[te])^2) /
    sum((y_clean[te] - mean(y_clean[tr]))^2)
}

cat(sprintf("  Training R²:    %.3f\n", r2_final))
cat(sprintf("  Nested CV R²:  %.3f ± %.3f\n", mean(final_nested_r2), sd(final_nested_r2)))

rf_final <- randomForest(x = X_final, y = y_clean, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)
r2_rf_final <- 1 - sum((rf_final$predicted - y_clean)^2) /
  sum((y_clean - mean(y_clean))^2)

cat(sprintf("  Random forest OOB R²: %.3f\n", r2_rf_final))
```

```{r PART 9: Plot}
core6_proteins <- core6$UniProt
plot_protein_scatter_partial <- function(protein_id, protein_name, gene_name) {prot_l2fc <- l2fc_matrix[protein_id, ]
  plot_data <- data.frame(
    Compound = names(prot_l2fc),
    Log2FC = as.numeric(prot_l2fc),
    Inhibition_Rate = compound_metrics$Inhibition_Rate,
    Log10_Conc = compound_metrics$Log10_Conc,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Log2FC) & !is.na(Inhibition_Rate) & !is.na(Log10_Conc))
  rx <- rank(plot_data$Log2FC)
  ry <- rank(plot_data$Inhibition_Rate)
  rz <- rank(plot_data$Log10_Conc)

  res_x <- residuals(lm(rx ~ rz))
  res_y <- residuals(lm(ry ~ rz))

  cor_partial <- cor.test(res_x, res_y, method = "spearman")
  prot_info <- core6 %>% filter(UniProt == protein_id)
  partial_info <- partial_results %>% filter(Protein == protein_id)

  if (nrow(partial_info) > 0) {
    partial_rho <- partial_info$Partial_rho
    partial_p <- partial_info$Partial_p
  } else {
    partial_rho <- cor_partial$estimate
    partial_p <- cor_partial$p.value
  }
  annotation_text <- sprintf(
    "Partial ρ = %.3f\np = %.2e\n(conc-controlled)\nn = %d",
    partial_rho,
    partial_p,
    nrow(plot_data)
  )

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Log2FC, y = Inhibition_Rate)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Log2FC), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_gradient(
      low = "#deebf7",
      high = "#5F6A8F",
      name = expression(log[2] * "FC")
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm", se = TRUE,
      color = "#5F6A8F", linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = min(plot_data$Log2FC) + 0.05 * diff(range(plot_data$Log2FC)),
      y = max(plot_data$Inhibition_Rate) - 0.05 * diff(range(plot_data$Inhibition_Rate)),
      label = annotation_text,
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4,
      color = "black", fontface = "bold",
      lineheight = 0.9
    ) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("%s (%s)", gene_name, protein_id),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "%s | Elastic Net Coef: %.4f | %s",
        prot_info$Function,
        prot_info$Coefficient,
        prot_info$Direction
      ),
      x = expression(log[2] * "FC"),
      y = "Inhibition (%)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray30"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
  ) %>%

  ry <- rank(plot_data$Inhibition_Rate)
  rz <- rank(plot_data$Log10_Conc)

  res_x <- residuals(lm(rx ~ rz))
  res_y <- residuals(lm(ry ~ rz))

  cor_partial <- cor.test(res_x, res_y, method = "spearman")
  prot_info <- core6 %>% filter(UniProt == protein_id)
  partial_info <- partial_results %>% filter(Protein == protein_id)

  if (nrow(partial_info) > 0) {
    partial_rho <- partial_info$Partial_rho
    partial_p <- partial_info$Partial_p
  } else {
    partial_rho <- cor_partial$estimate
    partial_p <- cor_partial$p.value
  }
  
  annotation_text <- sprintf(
    "Partial ρ = %.3f\np = %.2e\n(conc-controlled)\nn = %d",
    partial_rho,
    partial_p,
    nrow(plot_data)
  )

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Log2FC, y = Inhibition_Rate)) +

      high = color_scheme$high,
      name = expression(log[2] * "FC")
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm", se = TRUE,
      color = color_scheme$high,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = min(plot_data$Log2FC) + 0.05 * diff(range(plot_data$Log2FC)),
      y = max(plot_data$Inhibition_Rate) - 0.05 * diff(range(plot_data$Inhibition_Rate)),
      label = annotation_text,
      hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4,
      color = "black", fontface = "bold",
      lineheight = 0.9
    ) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("%s (%s)", gene_name, protein_id),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "%s | Elastic Net Coef: %.4f | %s",
        prot_info$Function,
        prot_info$Coefficient,
        prot_info$Direction
      ),
      x = expression(log[2] * "FC"),
      y = "Inhibition (%)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray30"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
smiles_data <- api_grouping %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMILES) & SMILES != "" & SMILES != "NA") %>%
  select(Compound_ID, Compound_Name, SMILES, API_Group_ID)

cat(sprintf("\nCompounds with valid SMILES: %d\n", nrow(smiles_data)))


if (requireNamespace("ChemmineR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  
  library(ChemmineR)
  
  cat("\nPerforming chemical similarity analysis using ChemmineR...\n")
  
  # Convert SMILES to SDF
  sdf_list <- tryCatch({
    smiles_vec <- setNames(smiles_data$SMILES, smiles_data$Compound_ID)
    smiles2sdf <- smiles2sdf(smiles_vec)
    smiles2sdf
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("SMILES conversion failed, possibly due to invalid structures. Checking individually...\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  if (!is.null(sdf_list)) {
    # Generate molecular fingerprints (ECFP-like: AP - Atom Pair)
    apset <- sdf2ap(sdf_list)
    
    # Calculate the Tanimoto similarity matrix
    sim_matrix <- sapply(cid(apset), function(x) {
      sapply(cid(apset), function(y) {
        cmp.similarity(apset[x], apset[y])
      })
    })
    
    rownames(sim_matrix) <- colnames(sim_matrix) <- names(sdf_list)
    
    cat(sprintf("Similarity matrix dimensions: %d × %d\n", nrow(sim_matrix), ncol(sim_matrix)))
    
    # Convert to a distance matrix
    dist_matrix <- as.dist(1 - sim_matrix)
    
  } else {
    cat("⚠️ ChemmineR approach failed\n")
    sim_matrix <- NULL
  }
  
} else {
  cat("⚠️ ChemmineR is not installed. To install it, run:\n")
  cat('  if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager")) install.packages("BiocManager")\n')
  cat('  BiocManager::install("ChemmineR")\n\n')
  sim_matrix <- NULL
}

if (is.null(sim_matrix)) {
  
  cat("\n═══ No R cheminformatics package is available ═══\n")
  cat("Exporting SMILES for processing with Python RDKit...\n\n")
  
  write.csv(
    smiles_data %>% select(Compound_ID, SMILES),
    file.path(data_dir, "smiles_for_python.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("Exported: smiles_for_python.csv\n")
  cat("Please run the following Python script:\n\n")
  
  cat('
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Python Script: calculate_tanimoto.py
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import pandas as pd
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit import DataStructs
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv("smiles_for_python.csv")

# Generate molecular objects
df["mol"] = df["SMILES"].apply(lambda x: Chem.MolFromSmiles(x))
df = df[df["mol"].notna()].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Valid molecules: {len(df)}")

# Generate ECFP4 fingerprints
df["fp"] = df["mol"].apply(lambda x: AllChem.GetMorganFingerprintAsBitVect(x, 2, nBits=2048))

# Calculate the Tanimoto similarity matrix
n = len(df)
sim_matrix = np.zeros((n, n))

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i, n):
        sim = DataStructs.TanimotoSimilarity(df["fp"].iloc[i], df["fp"].iloc[j])
        sim_matrix[i, j] = sim_matrix[j, i] = sim

# Convert to DataFrame
sim_df = pd.DataFrame(
    sim_matrix,
    index=df["Compound_ID"],
    columns=df["Compound_ID"]
)

# Export
sim_df.to_csv("tanimoto_similarity_matrix.csv")
print("✓ Exported: tanimoto_similarity_matrix.csv")
')

cat("\nAfter running the script, place tanimoto_similarity_matrix.csv in the same directory\n")
cat("and then continue running the R code.\n\n")
```

```{r}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. Clustering Based on Chemical Similarity
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if (!is.null(sim_matrix)) {
  
  # 4.1 Hierarchical clustering
  hc <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "average")
  
  # 4.2 Cut the dendrogram at different thresholds
  # Tanimoto > 0.85 → distance < 0.15
  SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD <- 0.85
  clusters <- cutree(hc, h = 1 - SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD)
  
  cluster_df <- data.frame(
    Compound_ID = names(clusters),
    Similarity_Cluster = clusters,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Summary statistics
  cluster_summary <- cluster_df %>%
    group_by(Similarity_Cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      N_Compounds = n(),
      Compound_IDs = paste(Compound_ID, collapse = ", ")
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(N_Compounds))
  
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n═══ Chemical Similarity Clustering (Tanimoto > %.2f) ═══\n",
    SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD
  ))
  cat(sprintf("Total clusters: %d\n", nrow(cluster_summary)))
  cat(sprintf("Singletons: %d\n", sum(cluster_summary$N_Compounds == 1)))
  cat(sprintf("Clusters with ≥2 compounds: %d\n", sum(cluster_summary$N_Compounds >= 2)))
  
  cat("\nTop 10 largest clusters:\n")
  print(head(cluster_summary, 10))
  
  # Export
write.xlsx(cluster_summary, file.path(data_dir,"02_Chemical_Similarity_Clusters.xlsx"))
  
  
  # 4.3 Visualize the chemical similarity heatmap
  # Display only the subset containing chemically similar compounds
  large_clusters <- cluster_summary %>% filter(N_Compounds >= 2) %>% pull(Similarity_Cluster)
  
  if (length(large_clusters) > 0) {
    
    compounds_in_clusters <- cluster_df %>%
      filter(Similarity_Cluster %in% large_clusters) %>%
      pull(Compound_ID)
    
    sim_subset <- sim_matrix[
      rownames(sim_matrix) %in% compounds_in_clusters,
      colnames(sim_matrix) %in% compounds_in_clusters
    ]
    
    # Heatmap annotation
    annotation_df <- cluster_df %>%
      filter(Compound_ID %in% compounds_in_clusters) %>%
      column_to_rownames("Compound_ID")
    
    pdf(file.path(fig_dir, "Chemical_Similarity_Heatmap.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
    pheatmap(
      sim_subset,
      clustering_distance_rows = dist_matrix,
      clustering_distance_cols = dist_matrix,
      clustering_method = "average",
      annotation_row = annotation_df,
      annotation_col = annotation_df,
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#deebf7", "#3182bd"))(100),
      main = sprintf("Chemical Similarity (Tanimoto, threshold=%.2f)", SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD),
      fontsize = 8
    )
    dev.off()
    
    cat("\n✓ Heatmap saved: Chemical_Similarity_Heatmap.pdf\n")
  }
  
  
  # 4.4 Dendrogram visualization
  pdf(file.path(fig_dir, "Chemical_Similarity_Dendrogram.pdf"), width = 12, height = 6)
  
  dend <- as.dendrogram(hc)
  dend <- color_branches(dend, h = 1 - SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD, groupLabels = TRUE)
  
  plot(dend, main = sprintf("Hierarchical Clustering (Tanimoto Similarity, cut at %.2f)", SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD))
  abline(h = 1 - SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
  
  dev.off()
  
  cat("✓ Dendrogram saved: Chemical_Similarity_Dendrogram.pdf\n")
  
} else {
  
  cat("\n⚠️ Skipping chemical similarity clustering because the similarity matrix was not generated\n")
  cluster_df <- data.frame(
    Compound_ID = smiles_data$Compound_ID,
    Similarity_Cluster = 1:nrow(smiles_data)  # Assign each compound to an individual group
  )
  
}# Ignore errors
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 6. Integrate All Grouping Information
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

compound_grouping_final <- moa_grouping %>%
  left_join(
    cluster_df %>% select(Compound_ID, Similarity_Cluster),
    by = "Compound_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Assign a unique ID to compounds without chemical similarity clustering information
    Similarity_Cluster = ifelse(
      is.na(Similarity_Cluster),
      max(Similarity_Cluster, na.rm = TRUE) + row_number(),
      Similarity_Cluster
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Compound_ID, Compound_Name, Variant_Type, Active_Ingredient,
    API, API_Group_ID, API_Group_Size, Has_Variants,
    Primary_Target_Clean, MOA_Group_ID, MOA_Group_Size,
    Similarity_Cluster,
    SMILES, Class, Subclass, Pathways,
    everything()
  )

# Export the final grouping table
write.xlsx(
  compound_grouping_final,
  file.path(data_dir,"04_Compound_Grouping_Complete.xlsx"
))
```

```{r}
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Step 1: Prepare the Dataset for Validation
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(dplyr)

# Create the complete modeling data frame using only compounds with inhibition-rate measurements
modeling_data <- compound_metrics %>%
  filter(!is.na(Inhibition_Rate)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Handle missing grouping IDs
    API_Group = ifelse(
      is.na(API_Group) | API_Group == "", 
      paste0("Single_API_", row_number()), 
      as.character(API_Group)
    ),
    
    Similarity_Group = ifelse(
      is.na(Similarity_Group) | Similarity_Group == "", 
      paste0("Single_Cluster_", row_number()), 
      as.character(Similarity_Group)
    ),
    
    MOA_Group = ifelse(
      is.na(MOA_Group) | MOA_Group == "" | MOA_Group == "Unknown", 
      "Unknown", 
      as.character(MOA_Group)
    ),
    
    # Create a combined grouping variable (most conservative strategy)
    Combined_Group = paste(API_Group, Similarity_Group, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Combined_Group_ID = as.integer(factor(Combined_Group))
  )

cat(sprintf("Total compounds available for validation: %d\n", nrow(modeling_data)))

# Summarize each grouping strategy
cat("\nNumber of groups under each grouping strategy:\n")
cat(sprintf("  API groups: %d\n", n_distinct(modeling_data$API_Group)))
cat(sprintf("  Similarity clusters: %d\n", n_distinct(modeling_data$Similarity_Group)))
cat(sprintf("  MOA groups (excluding Unknown): %d\n", 
            n_distinct(modeling_data$MOA_Group[modeling_data$MOA_Group != "Unknown"])))
cat(sprintf("  Combined groups: %d\n", n_distinct(modeling_data$Combined_Group_ID)))

# Save for subsequent use
write.xlsx(modeling_data, file.path(data_dir,"modeling_data_with_groups.xlsx"), rowNames = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VALIDATION 1: Leave-One-API-Out CV
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n")
cat("  Starting Validation 1/3: Leave-One-API-Out Cross-Validation\n")
cat("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n")

library(glmnet)

# Summarize API group sizes
api_group_sizes <- modeling_data %>%
  group_by(API_Group) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(N))

cat("API group-size distribution:\n")
print(table(api_group_sizes$N))

# Test only API groups with at least two samples
api_groups_to_test <- api_group_sizes %>%
  filter(N >= 2) %>%
  pull(API_Group)

cat(sprintf("\nNumber of API groups to test: %d\n", length(api_groups_to_test)))
cat(sprintf("Compound coverage: %d/%d (%.1f%%)\n\n",
            sum(modeling_data$API_Group %in% api_groups_to_test),
            nrow(modeling_data),
            sum(modeling_data$API_Group %in% api_groups_to_test) / nrow(modeling_data) * 100))

# Initialize result containers
api_cv_results <- list()
api_cv_predictions <- data.frame()

# Progress bar
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(api_groups_to_test), style = 3)

# Start Leave-One-API-Out CV
for (i in seq_along(api_groups_to_test)) {
  
  test_api <- api_groups_to_test[i]
  
  # Obtain training/test compounds
  train_compounds <- modeling_data %>% 
    filter(API_Group != test_api) %>% 
    pull(Compound)
  
  test_compounds <- modeling_data %>% 
    filter(API_Group == test_api) %>% 
    pull(Compound)
  
  # Identify indices in X_final
  # Note: rownames of X_final should correspond to compound IDs
  train_idx <- which(rownames(X_final) %in% train_compounds)
  test_idx <- which(rownames(X_final) %in% test_compounds)
  
  # Skip cases where the training set is too small
  if (length(train_idx) < 30 || length(test_idx) < 2) {
    next
  }
  
  # Prepare training/test data
  X_train <- X_final[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  y_train <- y_clean[train_idx]
  X_test <- X_final[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  y_test <- y_clean[test_idx]
  
  # Train Elastic Net
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    X_train, y_train,
    alpha = 0.5,
    nfolds = min(5, length(train_idx)),
    penalty.factor = penalty_final
  )
  
  # Predict
  pred <- predict(cv_fit, X_test, s = "lambda.min")[, 1]
  
  # Calculate performance metrics
  if (length(pred) >= 2 && sd(pred) > 0) {
    r2 <- cor(pred, y_test, use = "complete.obs")^2
    rho_test <- cor.test(pred, y_test, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
    mae <- mean(abs(pred - y_test))
    rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - y_test)^2))
  } else {
    r2 <- NA; rho_test <- list(estimate = NA, p.value = NA)
    mae <- NA; rmse <- NA
  }
  
  # Save fold-level metrics
  api_cv_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    Fold = i,
    API_Group = test_api,
    N_Train = length(train_idx),
    N_Test = length(test_idx),
    R2 = r2,
    Spearman_rho = rho_test$estimate,
    Spearman_p = rho_test$p.value,
    MAE = mae,
    RMSE = rmse,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Save predictions
  api_cv_predictions <- rbind(api_cv_predictions, data.frame(
    Compound = test_compounds,
    Observed = y_test,
    Predicted = pred,
    API_Group = test_api,
    Fold = i,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
  
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
}
close(pb)

# Combine fold-level metrics
api_cv_metrics <- bind_rows(api_cv_results)

# Calculate overall performance
api_overall_rho <- cor.test(
  api_cv_predictions$Predicted,
  api_cv_predictions$Observed,
  method = "spearman",
  exact = FALSE
)

api_overall_r2 <- cor(
  api_cv_predictions$Predicted,
  api_cv_predictions$Observed,
  use = "complete.obs"
)^2

# Report results
cat("\n\n★ Leave-One-API-Out CV Summary ★\n")
cat("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n")
cat(sprintf("Completed folds: %d\n", nrow(api_cv_metrics)))
cat(sprintf("Total predicted samples: %d\n", nrow(api_cv_predictions)))
cat(sprintf("\n【Overall Performance】\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Spearman ρ: %.3f (p = %.2e)\n", 
            api_overall_rho$estimate, api_overall_rho$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  R²: %.3f\n", api_overall_r2))
cat(sprintf("\n【Mean Fold Performance】\n"))
cat(sprintf("  R²: %.3f ± %.3f\n", 
            mean(api_cv_metrics$R2, na.rm = TRUE), 
            sd(api_cv_metrics$R2, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  MAE: %.2f ± %.2f\n", 
            mean(api_cv_metrics$MAE, na.rm = TRUE), 
            sd(api_cv_metrics$MAE, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  RMSE: %.2f ± %.2f\n", 
            mean(api_cv_metrics$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE), 
            sd(api_cv_metrics$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Save results
library(openxlsx)
write.xlsx(
  list(
    "Summary" = data.frame(
      Metric = c("Overall_Spearman_rho", "Overall_R2", "Mean_Fold_R2", "Mean_MAE", "Mean_RMSE"),
      Value = c(api_overall_rho$estimate, api_overall_r2, 
                mean(api_cv_metrics$R2, na.rm = TRUE),
                mean(api_cv_metrics$MAE, na.rm = TRUE),
                mean(api_cv_metrics$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE))
    ),
    "Fold_Metrics" = api_cv_metrics,
    "Predictions" = api_cv_predictions
  ),
  file.path(data_dir,"Leave_One_API_Out_Results.xlsx"
))

cat("\n✓ Results saved: Leave_One_API_Out_Results.xlsx\n")
```

```{r}
    Spearman_p = rho_test$p.value,
    MAE = mae,
    RMSE = rmse,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  cluster_cv_predictions <- rbind(cluster_cv_predictions, data.frame(
    Compound = test_compounds,
    Observed = y_test,
    Predicted = pred,
    Cluster = test_cluster,
    Fold = i,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
  
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
}
close(pb)

# Combine results
cluster_cv_metrics <- bind_rows(cluster_cv_results)

cluster_overall_rho <- cor.test(
  cluster_cv_predictions$Predicted,
  cluster_cv_predictions$Observed,
  method = "spearman",
  exact = FALSE
)

cluster_overall_r2 <- cor(
  cluster_cv_predictions$Predicted,
  cluster_cv_predictions$Observed,
  use = "complete.obs"
)^2

# Report results
cat("\n\n★ Leave-One-Cluster-Out CV Summary ★\n")
cat("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n")
cat(sprintf("Completed folds: %d\n", nrow(cluster_cv_metrics)))
cat(sprintf("Total predicted samples: %d\n", nrow(cluster_cv_predictions)))
cat(sprintf("\n【Overall Performance】\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Spearman ρ: %.3f (p = %.2e)\n", 
            cluster_overall_rho$estimate, cluster_overall_rho$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  R²: %.3f\n", cluster_overall_r2))
cat(sprintf("\n【Mean Fold Performance】\n"))
cat(sprintf("  R²: %.3f ± %.3f\n", 
            mean(cluster_cv_metrics$R2, na.rm = TRUE), 
            sd(cluster_cv_metrics$R2, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Save results
write.xlsx(
  list(
    "Summary" = data.frame(
      Metric = c("Overall_Spearman_rho", "Overall_R2", "Mean_Fold_R2"),
      Value = c(cluster_overall_rho$estimate, cluster_overall_r2, 
                mean(cluster_cv_metrics$R2, na.rm = TRUE))
    ),
    "Fold_Metrics" = cluster_cv_metrics,
    "Predictions" = cluster_cv_predictions
  ),
  file.path(data_dir,"Leave_One_Cluster_Out_Results.xlsx"
))


```

```{r}
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VALIDATION 3: Leave-One-MOA-Out CV
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n")
cat("  Starting Validation 3/3: Leave-One-MOA-Out Cross-Validation\n")
cat("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n")

# Summarize MOA group sizes (excluding Unknown)
moa_sizes <- modeling_data %>%
  filter(MOA_Group != "Unknown") %>%
  group_by(MOA_Group) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Target = first(Primary_Target_Clean),  # If available
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(N))

cat("MOA/Target group-size distribution:\n")
print(table(moa_sizes$N))

# Test only MOA groups with N ≥ 5 to ensure statistical robustness
moa_to_test <- moa_sizes %>%
  filter(N >= 5) %>%
  pull(MOA_Group)

cat(sprintf("\nNumber of MOA groups to test: %d\n", length(moa_to_test)))
cat(sprintf("Compound coverage: %d/%d (%.1f%%)\n\n",
            sum(modeling_data$MOA_Group %in% moa_to_test),
            nrow(modeling_data),
            sum(modeling_data$MOA_Group %in% moa_to_test) / nrow(modeling_data) * 100))

# Initialize result containers
moa_cv_results <- list()
moa_cv_predictions <- data.frame()

# Progress bar
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(moa_to_test), style = 3)

# Leave-One-MOA-Out
for (i in seq_along(moa_to_test)) {
  
  test_moa <- moa_to_test[i]
  
  train_compounds <- modeling_data %>% 
    filter(MOA_Group != test_moa) %>% 
    pull(Compound)
  
  test_compounds <- modeling_data %>% 
    filter(MOA_Group == test_moa) %>% 
    pull(Compound)
  
  train_idx <- which(rownames(X_final) %in% train_compounds)
  test_idx <- which(rownames(X_final) %in% test_compounds)
  
  if (length(train_idx) < 30 || length(test_idx) < 3) {
    next
  }
  
  X_train <- X_final[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  y_train <- y_clean[train_idx]
  X_test <- X_final[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  y_test <- y_clean[test_idx]
  
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    X_train, y_train,
    alpha = 0.5,
    nfolds = min(5, length(train_idx)),
    penalty.factor = penalty_final
  )
  
  pred <- predict(cv_fit, X_test, s = "lambda.min")[, 1]
  
  if (length(pred) >= 3 && sd(pred) > 0) {
    r2 <- cor(pred, y_test, use = "complete.obs")^2
    rho_test <- cor.test(pred, y_test, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
    mae <- mean(abs(pred - y_test))
    rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - y_test)^2))
  } else {
    r2 <- NA; rho_test <- list(estimate = NA, p.value = NA)
    mae <- NA; rmse <- NA
  }
  
  # Obtain the target name
  target_name <- modeling_data %>% 
    filter(MOA_Group == test_moa) %>% 
    pull(Primary_Target_Clean) %>% 
    first()
  
  if (is.null(target_name) || is.na(target_name)) {
    target_name <- test_moa
  }
  
  moa_cv_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    Fold = i,
    MOA_Group = test_moa,
    Target_Name = target_name,
    N_Train = length(train_idx),
    N_Test = length(test_idx),
    R2 = r2,
    Spearman_rho = rho_test$estimate,
    Spearman_p = rho_test$p.value,
    MAE = mae,
    RMSE = rmse,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  moa_cv_predictions <- rbind(moa_cv_predictions, data.frame(
    Compound = test_compounds,
    Observed = y_test,
    Predicted = pred,
    MOA_Group = test_moa,
    Target = target_name,
    Fold = i,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
  
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
}
close(pb)

# Combine results
moa_cv_metrics <- bind_rows(moa_cv_results)

moa_overall_rho <- cor.test(
  moa_cv_predictions$Predicted,
  moa_cv_predictions$Observed,
  method = "spearman",
  exact = FALSE
)

moa_overall_r2 <- cor(
  moa_cv_predictions$Predicted,
  moa_cv_predictions$Observed,
  use = "complete.obs"
)^2

# Report results
cat("\n\n★ Leave-One-MOA-Out CV Summary ★\n")
cat("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n")
cat(sprintf("Completed folds: %d\n", nrow(moa_cv_metrics)))
cat(sprintf("Total predicted samples: %d\n", nrow(moa_cv_predictions)))
cat(sprintf("\n【Overall Performance】\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Spearman ρ: %.3f (p = %.2e)\n", 
            moa_overall_rho$estimate, moa_overall_rho$p.value))
cat(sprintf("  R²: %.3f\n", moa_overall_r2))
cat(sprintf("\n【Mean Fold Performance】\n"))
cat(sprintf("  R²: %.3f ± %.3f\n", 
            mean(moa_cv_metrics$R2, na.rm = TRUE), 
            sd(moa_cv_metrics$R2, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Identify MOA groups that are difficult to predict
cat("\n【Performance by MOA】\n")
moa_performance <- moa_cv_metrics %>%
  arrange(R2) %>%
  select(Target_Name, N_Test, R2, Spearman_rho)

print(moa_performance)

# Save results
write.xlsx(
  list(
    "Summary" = data.frame(
      Metric = c("Overall_Spearman_rho", "Overall_R2", "Mean_Fold_R2"),
      Value = c(moa_overall_rho$estimate, moa_overall_r2, 
                mean(moa_cv_metrics$R2, na.rm = TRUE))
    ),
    "Fold_Metrics" = moa_cv_metrics,
    "MOA_Performance" = moa_performance,
    "Predictions" = moa_cv_predictions
  ),
  file.path(data_dir,"Leave_One_MOA_Out_Results.xlsx"
))

cat("\n✓ Results saved: Leave_One_MOA_Out_Results.xlsx\n")
```

```{r}
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART: Fully Nested Feature Selection
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

set.seed(123)
N_OUTER <- 5

outer_folds <- sample(rep(1:N_OUTER, length.out = nrow(X_clean)))

fully_nested_results <- list()
selected_proteins_per_fold <- list()

for (k in 1:N_OUTER) {
  cat(sprintf("\n═══ Outer Fold %d/%d ═══\n", k, N_OUTER))
  
  train_idx <- which(outer_folds != k)
  test_idx <- which(outer_folds == k)
  
  X_train_fold <- X_clean[train_idx, ]
  y_train_fold <- y_clean[train_idx]
  
  # ── Step 1: Recalculate partial correlations within the training set ──
  partial_results_fold <- data.frame(
    Protein = colnames(X_train_fold)[colnames(X_train_fold) != "Log10_Conc"],
    Partial_p = NA_real_
  )
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(partial_results_fold))) {
    prot_name <- partial_results_fold$Protein[i]
    pc <- partial_spearman(
      X_train_fold[, prot_name],
      y_train_fold,
      X_train_fold[, "Log10_Conc"]
    )
    partial_results_fold$Partial_p[i] <- pc$p
  }
  
  partial_results_fold$Partial_FDR <- p.adjust(
    partial_results_fold$Partial_p, method = "BH"
  )
  
  sig_proteins_fold <- partial_results_fold %>%
    filter(Partial_FDR < 0.05) %>%
    pull(Protein)
  
  cat(sprintf("  Significant proteins in fold %d: %d\n", k, length(sig_proteins_fold)))
  
  # ── Step 2: Elastic Net feature selection ──
  X_train_sig <- X_train_fold[, c(sig_proteins_fold, "Log10_Conc")]
  penalty_fold <- c(rep(1, length(sig_proteins_fold)), 0)
  
  cv_fold <- cv.glmnet(
    X_train_sig, y_train_fold,
    alpha = 0.5,
    penalty.factor = penalty_fold
  )
  
  coef_fold <- coef(cv_fold, s = "lambda.min")
  elastic_selected_fold <- setdiff(
    rownames(coef_fold)[coef_fold[, 1] != 0],
    c("(Intercept)", "Log10_Conc")
  )
  
  
  # ── Step 4: Select the top N proteins (six proteins here) ──
  # Rank proteins by absolute coefficient magnitude
  protein_coefs_fold <- data.frame(
    Protein = elastic_selected_fold,
    Coefficient = sapply(elastic_selected_fold, function(p) coef_fold[p, 1])
  ) %>%
    mutate(Abs_Coef = abs(Coefficient)) %>%
    arrange(desc(Abs_Coef)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 6)
  
  selected_proteins_fold <- protein_coefs_fold$Protein
  selected_proteins_per_fold[[k]] <- selected_proteins_fold
  
  cat(sprintf("  Selected proteins: %s\n", paste(selected_proteins_fold, collapse = ", ")))
  
  # ── Step 5: Predict on the test set ──
  X_test_fold <- X_clean[test_idx, c(selected_proteins_fold, "Log10_Conc")]
  X_train_final <- X_clean[train_idx, c(selected_proteins_fold, "Log10_Conc")]
  
  cv_final_fold <- cv.glmnet(
    X_train_final, y_train_fold,
    alpha = 0.5,
    penalty.factor = c(rep(1, length(selected_proteins_fold)), 0)
  )
  
  pred_fold <- predict(cv_final_fold, X_test_fold, s = "lambda.min")[, 1]
  
  fully_nested_results[[k]] <- data.frame(
    Fold = k,
    Compound = rownames(X_clean)[test_idx],
    Observed = y_clean[test_idx],
    Predicted = pred_fold
  )
}

# ── Summarize results ──
all_predictions <- do.call(rbind, fully_nested_results)

fully_nested_r2 <- cor(all_predictions$Predicted, all_predictions$Observed)^2
fully_nested_rho <- cor.test(
  all_predictions$Predicted, all_predictions$Observed,
  method = "spearman"
)

cat(sprintf(
  "\n★ Fully Nested CV Performance:\n  R² = %.3f\n  Spearman ρ = %.3f (p = %.2e)\n",
  fully_nested_r2, fully_nested_rho$estimate, fully_nested_rho$p.value
))

# ── Protein selection consistency ──
all_selected <- unlist(selected_proteins_per_fold)
protein_selection_freq <- table(all_selected) / N_OUTER * 100

cat("\n★ Protein selection frequency across folds:\n")
print(sort(protein_selection_freq, decreasing = TRUE))

common_proteins <- names(protein_selection_freq)[protein_selection_freq == 100]
cat(sprintf("\nProteins selected in ALL folds: %s\n", paste(common_proteins, collapse = ", ")))
```

```{r}
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat("\n\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n")
cat("  Comprehensive Comparison: All Validation Strategies\n")

    "Leave-One-API-Out",
    "Leave-One-Cluster-Out",
    "Leave-One-MOA-Out"
  ),
  Spearman_rho = c(
    0.594,  #
    mean(final_nested_r2)^0.5,

    api_overall_rho$estimate,

    moa_overall_rho$estimate
  ),
  R2 = c(
    0.389,
    mean(final_nested_r2),  
    0.136,
    api_overall_r2,
    cluster_overall_r2,
    moa_overall_r2
  ),
  N_Predictions = c(
    nrow(modeling_data),
    nrow(modeling_data),
    nrow(all_predictions),  
    nrow(api_cv_predictions),

    nrow(moa_cv_predictions)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Visualize performance comparison

  labs(

    subtitle = "Spearman correlation (higher = better)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Spearman ρ"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_comparison)

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir,"Validation_Methods_Comparison.pdf"), p_comparison, width = 10, height = 6)

# Save comparison table
write.xlsx(comparison_table, file.path(data_dir,"All_Validation_Methods_Comparison.xlsx"))
```
